blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Rapidly evolving LLM architectures and heterogeneous mobile hardware make supporting new models in on-device inference engines a recurring and costly system challenge. Each model may require coordinated changes across conversion, graph construction, operators, and hardware backends. Existing coding agents often miss these cross-layer dependencies and struggle to diagnose failures across host--device execution paths. We present EngineAgent, an agentic system for automating on-device LLM model enablement. Its key insight is to separate reusable engine and hardware knowledge from model-specific implementation. Before enablement, EngineAgent constructs a hierarchy-aware engine index that captures engine abstraction layers and cross-layer dependencies, and pre-validates backend-specific build, execution, and debugging workflows using already supported models. For each new model, a builder uses this knowledge to coordinate cross-layer changes, while an auditor checks implementation completeness and drives iterative debugging through device-side validation. Across 12 tasks spanning three mobile LLMs and four engine--backend pairs on CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs, EngineAgent achieves 75% end-to-end success with either of two underlying LLMs, versus 33.3% for the strongest coding-agent baseline. Success requires compilation, on-device execution, and output-logit agreement with reference implementations. EngineAgent also reduces average per-task time and model-API cost relative to baselines using the same underlying LLMs.
blocks.zh: 快速演变的LLM架构和多样的移动硬件使得支持基于设备推论引擎的新模型成为反复出现且成本高昂的系统挑战. 每个模型可能需要在转换、图表构建、操作员和硬件后端之间进行协调的改变。 现有的编码代理经常会错过这些跨层的依赖性,并努力在主机-设备执行路径中诊断出失败. 我们呈现的是引擎代理,一种用于在设备上自动化LLM模型的代理系统. 其关键见解是将可重复使用的引擎和硬件知识与模型特定实施相分离. 在启用前,EngineAgent会构建一个分级意识的引擎索引来捕捉引擎抽象层和跨层依赖性,并使用已经支持的模型预先验证后端特定构建,执行,并调试工作流程. 对于每个新模型,一个构建者利用这种知识来协调跨层变化,而审计师则通过设备侧面验证来检查执行完整性并驱动迭代调试. 在整个12项任务中,在CPU、GPU和NPU上跨越了3个移动LLM和4个引擎后端对,引擎代理公司以2个基础LLM中的任何1个都实现了75%的端到端成功,而最强编码代理基线则达到了33.3%。 成功需要汇编、现场执行和产出记录协议以及参考执行。 Engine Agent还使用相同的基础LLMs,相对基线而言,降低每个任务的平均时间和模型-API成本.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en:
On-device LLM inference engines are critical middleware positioned between two distinct ecosystems: rapidly evolving LLM model architectures above and a fragmented landscape of heterogeneous mobile hardware below.
Engine developers must continuously extend their engines to support previously unsupported model architectures and capabilities while ensuring their correct execution across underlying diverse mobile CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs.
blocks.zh:
On-device LLM推论引擎是位于两个不同生态系统之间的关键中间软件:上面快速演化的LLM模型架构和下面各异移动硬件的零散景观.
引擎开发者必须不断扩展他们的引擎,以支持先前没有支持的模型架构和能力,同时确保它们正确执行,贯穿于基础多样的移动CPU,GPU,和NPU.

blocks.en: On the model side, device-oriented lightweight LLM families evolve rapidly, with successive generations often released only months or even weeks apart. For instance, Gemma 3 to Gemma 3n only took about 4 months ( Team, 2025 ; Google DeepMind, 2025 ) , while MiniCPM-V 4.0 to 4.5 took only 24 days ( Yu et al., 2025 ) . More importantly, successive generations frequently introduce new modules and designs. Qwen3.5 ( Team, 2026 ) introduces GatedDeltaNet linear attention ( Yang et al., 2025 ) interleaved with conventional attention. Gemma4 ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) adds hybrid sliding-window/global attention, proportional RoPE (p-RoPE), unified keys and values, shared KV cache, and Per-Layer Embeddings (PLE). MiniCPM-V 4.6 further introduces a window-attention vit_merger, intra-ViT early compression, and mixed 4 × / 16 × 4\times/16\times visual-token compression ( OpenBMB, 2026 ) . Consequently, supporting one generation rarely guarantees support for its successors, forcing inference engines to repeatedly incorporate newly introduced model structures and modules.
blocks.zh: 在模型方面,面向装置的轻量级LLM家族迅速演化,历代人往往相隔数月甚至数周才释放出来. 例如,Gemma 3至Gemma 3n只用了大约4个月(Team,2025;Google DeepMind,2025),而MiniCPM-V 4.0至4.5只用了24天(Yu等人,2025)。 更重要的是,几代人经常引进新的模块和设计. Quen3.5(Team,2026)引入GatedDeltaNet的线性关注(Yang等人,2025年)与常规关注互换. Gemma4 (Google DeepMind, 2026) 增加了混合滑动窗/全球关注,比例ROPE(p-ROPE),统一键和值,共享KV缓存,以及Per-Layer Embeddings(PLE). MiniCPM-V 4.6 进一步引入了窗口注意vit_合并,ViT内部早期压缩,以及混合 4 × / 16 × 4\times/16\times 视觉托盘压缩(OpenBMB, 2026). 因此,支持一代人很少保证支持其继任者,迫使推论引擎反复纳入新引进的模型结构和模块。

blocks.en:
On the hardware side, mobile deployment is fragmented across heterogeneous execution backends. ARM CPUs, mobile GPUs ( Limited, 2020 ) , Qualcomm Hexagon NPUs ( Inc., 2026d ; Inc., 2026c ) , MediaTek APUs ( Inc., 2026b ) , and Apple Neural Engine ( Inc., 2026a ) differ substantially in programming languages and interfaces, tensor layouts, compilation workflows, and runtime semantics.
Therefore, supporting the same new LLM feature requires substantially different implementation paths across hardware backends. CPU backends may implement new operators directly in C/C++ or assembly; Vulkan GPUs may require dedicated compute shaders, SPIR-V compilation, and backend-specific dispatch logic; NPUs typically require graph rewriting, accelerator-specific lowering, and vendor-specific compilation.
Consequently, each newly introduced model feature need to be independently adapted and validated for multiple backends through entirely different engineering paths, multiplying the implementation efforts required for enablement.
blocks.zh:
在硬件方面,移动部署分散于各种执行后端。 ARMCPU,移动GPU(有限,2020年),Qualcomm Hixagon NPU(股份有限公司,2026d;股份有限公司,2026c),MediaTek APU(股份有限公司,2026b),Apple神经引擎(股份有限公司,2026a)在编程语言和界面,声波布局,编译工作流程,运行时语义等方面差异很大.
因此,支持相同的新的LLM特性,要求硬件后端的实现路径大不相同. CPU后端可能直接在 C/C++ 中执行新的操作符 Vulkan GPU可能要求专门的计算遮蔽器,SPIR-V编译,以及后端特定调度逻辑; NPU通常需要图表重写,加速器特定降低,以及供应商特定编译.
因此,每个新引进的模型特征都需要通过完全不同的工程路径对多个后端进行独立调整和验证,使赋能所需的执行努力成倍增加。

blocks.en:
Traditionally, enabling a new model remains a largely handcrafted, expert-driven process, requiring expertise spanning both LLM model architecture and thorough understanding of the inference engine stack.
Maintainers must analyze the new model semantics, map new model features onto engine modules, modify export and runtime execution paths, adapt operators or kernels, and validate execution on target backends.
For example, enabling Qwen3.5-2B in MNN ( Lv et al., 2022 ) touched 42 files and over 4.2K lines across export and execution runtime, shape inference, and both CPU and GPU backends, whereas ExecuTorch ( Foundation, 2025 ) introduced changes to 20 files and over 1K lines for text-only CPU support.
Such broad and heavy modifications impose substantial development and validation burdens on engine maintainers, which are also reflected in both incomplete backend and modality coverage and enablement delay .
As summarized in Table 2 , 2 out of the 4 on-device engines do not support Gemma4-E2B-it, while 3 out of the 4 do not support MiniCPM-V 4.6. Even when a model is supported, coverage is often restricted to only a subset of backends or modalities, such as CPU-only or text-only execution.
Moreover, initial on-device enablement can take up to 30 days after model release.
blocks.zh:
传统上,促成新的模型仍然是一个主要由专家推动的手工制作过程,需要跨越LLM模型结构和透彻理解推论引擎堆积的专门知识。
维护者必须分析新的模型语义,将新的模型特性映射到引擎模块上,修改导出和运行时间执行路径,调整操作员或内核,并在目标后端验证执行.
例如,在MNN(Lv et al., 2022)中启用Quen3.5-2B,在导出和执行运行时间,形状推论之间,以及CPU和GPU后端之间,触及了42份文件和超过4.2K行,而ExecuTorch(Foundation, 2025)则引入了对20份文件和超过1K行的修改,用于文本唯一的CPU支持.
这种广泛而繁重的修改给发动机维护者带来了很大的开发和验证负担,这也反映在后端和方式覆盖不全和使能延迟。
如表2所示,在4台安装式发动机中,有2台不支持Gemma4-E2B-it,而3台不支持MiniCPM-V 4.6. 即使在一个模型被支持的情况下,覆盖也往往被限制在只有子集的后端或模式上,如CPU只执行或文本只执行.
此外,在模型发布30天后,初步安装设备的启用时间可长达30天。

blocks.en: The substantial engineering burden naturally motivates us to agentize model enablement. Before a new model is released, agents should acquire reusable knowledge of the engine’s semantics and establish backend-specific debugging and verification workflows using already supported models. After release, agents should analyze the new model’s architecture, use this knowledge to identify and implement the required engine modifications, and iteratively debug and verify the implementation on real devices.
blocks.zh: 巨大的工程负担自然地促使我们将模型赋能化。 在发布新模型之前,代理商应当获得引擎语义的可重复使用的知识,并使用已经支持的模型建立后端特定的调试和验证工作流程. 发布后,代理商应分析新模型的架构,利用这种知识来识别和执行所需的引擎修改,并迭代调试和验证在真实设备上的实现.

blocks.en:
However, both localizing modifications within an engine and debugging and verifying them on real devices are fundamentally challenging. ① Challenges of mapping new model features across hierarchical engine abstractions. On-device LLM engines such as llama.cpp ( Gerganov, 2026 ) , MNN ( Lv et al., 2022 ) , ExecuTorch ( Foundation, 2025 ) , and MLC-LLM ( MLC team, 2023 ) , share a complex hierarchical organization that can be abstracted into multiple levels with distinct representations and manipulation logic.
At the input level, natural-language or visual inputs are transformed through tokenization or patchification; at the graph level, tensor computation is constructed, converted, fused, and scheduled as computation graphs; and at the operator level, computations are realized through backend-specific kernels and runtime dispatch.
During model enablement, a new feature may require coordinated modifications across these levels, yet their respective roles are not apparent from code structure alone.
Without understanding where a component lies in the engine hierarchy and what role that level plays in model execution, an agent may identify and modify locally relevant code while overlooking modifications required at other levels.
Therefore, reliable modification localization requires reasoning about the engine hierarchy rather than treating the codebase as a flat collection of files and symbols. ② Challenges of cross-device debugging and verification. Unlike conventional host-only software, where execution and debugging typically occur within the same environment, on-device model enablement follows a host–device, cross-language, build–debug pipeline spanning host-side preparation and device-side deployment and execution. As a result, a failure observed on device may originate from an earlier host-side stage rather than from the failing runtime itself. Moreover, mobile CPU, GPU, and NPU backends follow distinct compilation and runtime workflows, each requiring different debugging methods. Consequently, tracing failures back to their root causes across devices and backends is inherently challenging.
blocks.zh:
然而,在引擎内部将修改本地化以及调试和在真实设备上核实,都具有根本的挑战性。 1 跨层次引擎抽象图绘制新模型特征的挑战。 LLM引擎On-device LLM引擎如:lama.cpp(Gerganov, 2026年),MNN(Lv等人, 2022年),ExecuTorch(Foundation, 2025年),以及MLC-LLM(MLC团队, 2023年),共享一个复杂的层次组织,可以抽象为多个层次,具有不同的表述和操纵逻辑.
在输入层面,自然语言或视觉输入通过符号化或补丁化进行转换;在图表层面,拉诺计算被构建,转换,引信化,并被安排为计算图;在操作人员层面,通过后端特定内核和运行时间调度实现计算.
在模型启用期间,一个新的特征可能需要在这些级别上进行协调一致的修改,但仅从代码结构来看,它们各自的作用并不明显。
在不理解一个组件在引擎等级中的位置,以及该级别在模型执行中扮演什么角色的情况下,代理人可以识别和修改当地相关的代码,同时忽略其他级别所需要的修改.
因此,可靠的修改本地化需要对引擎等级进行推理,而不是将代码库视为文件和符号的平面集合. 2 交叉调试和核查的挑战。 与常规的仅主机软件不同,该软件的执行和调试一般发生在同一个环境中,在线调试模型的启用遵循主机-调试,跨语言,构建-调试管道贯穿主机-侧准备以及设备-侧部署和执行. 因此,在设备上观察到的故障可能源于较早的主机侧级,而不是故障运行时间本身. 此外,移动CPU,GPU,和NPU的后端遵循不同的编译和运行时间工作流程,每个工作流程都需要不同的调试方法. 因此,在各种装置和后端追查失败的根源本身就具有挑战性。

blocks.en:
Existing repository-level coding agents struggle with both challenges. ① Code structure centric knowledge rather than engine hierarchy knowledge. Existing agents ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024a ; Bairi et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) primarily reason over files, functions, symbols, and AST-level dependencies without explicitly modeling how these entities related to engine abstraction hierarchy.
Consequently, their reasoning and modifications are typically constrained to local changes of one or two modules, missing necessary modifications across distant abstraction layers, e.g., adding an operator definition without implementing its hardware kernel. ② Host-centric verification and debugging rather than cross-language, host–device, backend-specific workflows. Existing agents largely rely on language-specific, host-local static analysis, unit tests, and debug tracing ( Zhang et al., 2024b ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) .
They lack comparable capabilities for orchestrating and reasoning over host–device debug workflows, causing device deployments to fail, device-side failures to remain unattributed or misattributed, and debugging to fall back to repeated build–test attempts without precise localization. Even Codex ( OpenAI, 2026 ) powered by GPT-5.6-Sol exhibits both missing implementations and hardware-verification failures (Figure 9 ); for example, when enabling MiniCPM-V 4.6 on MNN–CPU, it stopped after an incomplete build and skipped device validation (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh:
现有的储存库一级的编码代理商在应对这两项挑战时都挣扎。 1 代码结构 中心知识 而不是引擎等级知识. 现有代理商(Chen等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2024年a;Bairi等人,2024年;Wang等人,2025年b)主要针对文件,功能,符号,以及AST级的依赖性,而没有明确模拟这些实体与引擎抽象级的关系.
因此,它们的推理和修改通常受限于一个或两个模块的局部变化,在遥远的抽象层中缺少必要的修改,如在不实施其硬件内核的情况下添加操作员定义. 2个 以主机为中心的校验和调试,而不是跨语言,主机–device,后端特定的工作流程. 现有剂主要依靠语言特异性,宿主-局部静态分析,单位测试,调试跟踪(张等,2024b;朱等,2025).
相对于主机-device调试工作流程,它们缺乏可比较的调节和推理能力,导致设备部署失败,设备侧的故障保持未属性或错误属性,调试会回到重复的构建-测试尝试,而不精确本地化. 甚至由GPT-5.6-Sol提供动力的Codex(OpenAI,2026年)也显示缺少执行和硬件验证故障(图9);例如,在MNN-CPU上启用MiniCPM-V 4.6时,在未完成的构建和跳过设备验证后停止(表2).

blocks.en:
We propose EngineAgent, an agentic system for reliable on-device LLM engine model enablement that automates the workflow while addressing the two challenges above.
EngineAgent consists of three key designs: a model-agnostic engine hierarchy knowledge index , hardware-aware debug skills , and a model-specific multi-agent implementation–audit main loop .
To address the lack of engine-hierarchy understanding, EngineAgent constructs a hierarchy-aware knowledge index (§ 5 ) that maps code structures onto engine abstraction layers and cross-layer dependencies, enabling agents to identify complete modification scopes beyond local code relations.
To address unreliable hardware-grounded debugging, EngineAgent constructs reusable build, test, and debugging skills (§ 4.3 ) by validating backend-specific workflows with already supported models, providing stable verification procedures for heterogeneous hardware.
These two designed artifacts are pre-constructed ahead of time because they are reusable and model-agnostic. Moreover, they are designed to be updatable upon new engine commits.
When a new model arrives, it enters the model-specific multi-agent enablement main loop (§ 4.4 ), where newly introduced model features are mapped onto the pre-constructed hierarchy knowledge index and hardware-aware debug skills.
The builder then plans and implements layer-wise modifications guided by the hierarchy index, and submits each completed change to the red-team auditor.
If validation fails, failures are routed to the builder with hardware-aware debugging support for iterative refinement.
The auditor accepts the implementation only after all layer-wise checks and end-to-end device validation pass.
blocks.zh:
我们提出引擎代理,一个用于可靠安装LLM引擎模型的代理系统,可以自动化工作流程,同时应对上述两项挑战。
EngineAgent由三种关键设计组成:模型不可知的引擎层级知识指数,硬件意识调试技能,以及模型特定多代理执行–审计主循环.
为解决缺乏引擎等级理解的问题,EngineAgent构建了一个分级认知知识指数(§5),将代码结构映射到引擎抽象层和跨层依赖性上,使代理能够识别超出本地代码关系的完整修改范围.
为了解决不可靠的硬件基于调试问题,Engine Agent构建了可重复使用的构建,测试,调试技能(§4.3),通过已经支持的模型验证后端特定工作流程,为多样化硬件提供稳定的核查程序.
这两件设计出来的文物是提前建造的,因为它们是可重复使用和模型不可知的. 此外,新发动机投入后,这些装置可以更新。
新模型到达后,它进入了模型特有的多剂赋能主循环(§4.4),其中新引入的模型特性被映射到预构的层次知识指数和硬件意识调试技能上.
建设者然后在分级索引的指导下规划和实施分层修改,并向红队审计员提交每个已完成的修改。
如果校验失败,则失败会以硬件意识调试支持路由到构建器,用于迭代改进.
审计员只有在经过所有层层检查和端到端设备验证合格后才接受实施。

blocks.en:
Together, EngineAgent supports reliable model enablement across heterogeneous inference engines and hardware backends.
We evaluate EngineAgent on 12 model-enablement tasks spanning 3 mobile LLMs and 4 engine–backend pairs that cover CPU, GPU, and NPU execution: MNN–CPU, llama.cpp–Vulkan, MLC-LLM–OpenCL, and ExecuTorch–QNN. EngineAgent achieves an end-to-end success rate of 75% , compared with 33.3% for the strongest coding-agent baseline.
blocks.zh:
Engine Agent公司共同支持跨不同推论引擎和硬件后端的可靠模型赋能.
我们评价引擎代理的12项模型可操作任务,涉及3个移动LLM和4个引擎 — 覆盖CPU、GPU和NPU执行的后端对:MNN-CPU、lama.cpp-Vulkan、MLC-LLM-OpenCL和ExecuTorch-NN。 Engine Agent实现端对端成功率75%,而最强编码代理基准为33.3%.

blocks.en: This work makes the following contributions: • We identify model enablement as a distinct cross-layer software-engineering problem for on-device LLM inference engines, and characterize its two key challenges: hierarchical system understanding and hardware-aware debugging and verification across heterogeneous devices and backends. • We design EngineAgent, an agentic system that addresses these challenges through three key components: a model-agnostic hierarchy-aware engine knowledge index that captures abstraction layers and cross-layer dependencies, hardware-aware debug skills that provide reusable and validated build–debug workflows, and a model-specific main loop that maps new model features onto these pre-constructed artifacts for layer-wise implementation, completeness auditing, device-side validation, and iterative refinement. • We evaluate EngineAgent on 12 model-enablement tasks across three mobile LLMs and four engine–backend pairs, demonstrating higher effectiveness and efficiency than existing coding agents across benchmark cases.
blocks.zh: 这项工作作出了以下贡献: 我们发现,模型赋能是一个独特的跨层软件工程问题,用于探测LLM推论引擎,并描述其两大挑战:分级系统理解和硬件意识调试,以及不同装置和后端的核查。 我们设计了“引擎代理”这一代理系统,它通过三个关键组成部分来应对这些挑战:一种模型-不可知级-了解引擎知识指数,它能捕捉抽象层和跨层依赖性,硬件-了解调试技能,提供可重复使用和经验证的构建-调试工作流程,以及一种模型特定的主要循环,将新的模型特征映射到这些预建的文物上,进行分层执行,完整性审计,设备侧验证和迭代改进。 我们评价引擎代理公司在3个移动LLM和4个引擎后端对的12个模型启用任务,显示在基准案件中,其效力和效率高于现有的编码代理公司。

blocks.en: We identify model enablement as a distinct cross-layer software-engineering problem for on-device LLM inference engines, and characterize its two key challenges: hierarchical system understanding and hardware-aware debugging and verification across heterogeneous devices and backends.
blocks.zh: 我们发现模型的增强能力是用于探测LLM推论引擎的一个独特的跨层软件工程问题,并描述其两个关键挑战:分级系统理解和硬件意识调试以及跨不同装置和后端的核查。

blocks.en: We design EngineAgent, an agentic system that addresses these challenges through three key components: a model-agnostic hierarchy-aware engine knowledge index that captures abstraction layers and cross-layer dependencies, hardware-aware debug skills that provide reusable and validated build–debug workflows, and a model-specific main loop that maps new model features onto these pre-constructed artifacts for layer-wise implementation, completeness auditing, device-side validation, and iterative refinement.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了“引擎代理”这一代理系统,它通过三个关键组成部分来应对这些挑战:一种模型-不可知的层次-了解引擎知识指数,它能够捕捉抽象层和跨层的依赖性;一种硬件-了解调试技能,提供可重复使用和验证的构建-调试工作流程;以及一种模型专用的主要循环,将新的模型特征映射到这些预构件上,以便进行层层执行、完整性审计、设备侧验证和迭代改进。

blocks.en: We evaluate EngineAgent on 12 model-enablement tasks across three mobile LLMs and four engine–backend pairs, demonstrating higher effectiveness and efficiency than existing coding agents across benchmark cases.
blocks.zh: 我们评价引擎代理公司在3个移动LLM和4个引擎后端对的12个模型启用任务,显示在基准案件中,其效力和效率高于现有的编码代理公司。

blocks.en: 2. Background
blocks.zh: 2. 背景情况

blocks.en: 2.1. On-Device LLM Inference Engines
blocks.zh: 2.1. 在线LLM 推论引擎

blocks.en:
On-device LLM inference engines provide the unified software infrastructure for executing diverse LLMs on mobile devices equipped with heterogeneous processors such as CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs.
Representative engines, including MNN ( Lv et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) , ExecuTorch ( Foundation, 2025 ) , llama.cpp ( Gerganov, 2026 ) , and MLC-LLM ( MLC team, 2023 ) , share a common two-stage architecture: an offline, on-host model export stage , realized by the engine’s converter and compiler, and an online, on-device execution stage , powered by the engine’s runtime.
Orthogonally, both stages are organized into the same three levels of abstraction: the input level (chat templates and tokenizers), the graph level (the computation graph and its intermediate representation, IR), and the operator level (backend kernels and their hardware mappings).
blocks.zh:
On-device LLM推论引擎提供统一软件基础设施,用于在移动设备上执行多种LLMs,配备了不同的处理器,如CPU,GPU,和NPU.
代表性引擎,包括MNN (Lv等人,2022年;Wang等人,2024年),ExecuTorch(基金会,2025年),lama.cpp (Gerganov,2026年),和MLC-LLM(MLC团队,2023年),共享一个共同的两阶段架构:一个离线的,在主机模型输出阶段,由发动机的转换器和编译器实现,以及一个在线的,在设备上的执行阶段,由发动机运行时间提供动力.
Orthogony,两个阶段都被组织成相同的三个抽象层次:输入级(聊天模板和指示器),图级(计算图及其中间代表,IR),操作级(后端内核及其硬件映射).

blocks.en:
As is illustrated in Figure 2 , the offline export stage traverses these three levels top-down. At the input level, it exports the chat template and the (multi-modal) tokenizer and packs them into the model artifact.
At the graph level, it maps PyTorch layers and modules onto engine-native IR nodes, applying transformations such as quantization, weight packing, layout reordering, and operator fusion.
At the operator level, it lowers and links each IR node to a hardware-specific kernel from the engine’s backend operator library.
Notably, certain engine–hardware pairs defer preparation to runtime via online just-in-time (JIT) compilation, such as the OpenCL backend for mobile GPUs in MNN but the JIT workflow mirrors its offline counterpart level for level.
The online execution stage traverses the same levels at inference time.
Engine runtime loads the prepared artifact, applies input-level pre-processing and tokenization to the user input, then walks the graph node by node, dispatching each node to its operator implementation.
blocks.zh:
如图2所示,离线出口阶段从上至下跨越这三个层次。 在输入层面,它输出聊天模板和(多模式)标致器,并将其装入模型文物.
在图层上,它将PyTorch层和模块映射到引擎内置的IR节点上,应用了量化,重量包装,布局重排,操作员聚变等变换.
在操作员层面,它从引擎的后端操作员库中将每个IR节点降低并链接到一个硬件特定的内核.
值得注意的是,某些引擎-硬件对子推迟通过在线即时编译(JIT)进行运行时间的准备,例如MNN中移动GPU的OpenCL后端,但JIT工作流程反射其离线对等级别.
在线执行阶段在推论时间会经历同样的水平.
引擎运行时间加载准备的文物,对用户输入应用输入级预处理和符号化,然后通过节点将图表节点行走,将每个节点发送到它的操作员执行中.

blocks.en:
In summary, although these engines differ in their IR designs and supported backends, they converge on the same two-stage,
three-level workflow.
This shared abstraction is what allows our analysis to generalize across engines rather than being tied to any single instance.
blocks.zh:
简而言之,虽然这些发动机在IR设计和支持后端上有所不同,但它们在相同的两个阶段上趋同,
三级工作流程.
这种共同的抽象是使我们的分析能够概括地跨越引擎,而不是与任何单一的例子挂钩。

blocks.zh: 图 2. 在线LLM引擎包括输出和执行阶段,它们共有三个抽象层。

blocks.en: 2.2. Model Enablement from Maintainers’ View
blocks.zh: 2.2. 维护者的模型启用 视图

blocks.en: For engine maintainers, supporting a new LLM in a mobile inference engine is a complicated engineering effort, involving two primary procedure: understanding the engine and mapping new model features to modifications across engine modules and abstraction layers, and perform the host-device coordinated verify-debug loop to debug. Figure 3 exemplifies these 2 major procedure.
blocks.zh: 对于引擎维护者来说,在移动推导引擎中支持一个新的LLM是一个复杂的工程努力,涉及两个主要程序:理解引擎和绘制跨引擎模块和抽象层修改的新模型特征,以及执行主机-device协调的校验-调试循环以调试. 图3说明了这两个主要程序。

blocks.en:
Maintainers first analyze newly introduced model features and determine how they map onto the engine’s abstraction levels and modules.
As illustrated by the example of mapping Qwen3.5-2B ( Team, 2026 ) to MNN ( Lv et al., 2022 ) in Figure 3(a) , changes such as new chat-template formats or multimodal settings (e.g., " <|im_start|> " and input visual patch size) are mapped to the input level; new model structures and tensor contracts such as the vision index tensor shape and data type are mapped to the graph level; newly introduced operations such as FusedLinearAttention ( Yang et al., 2025 ) must be lowered to operator level backend specific implementations, e.g., CPUFusedLinearAttention and its ARM64 NEON implementations.
After the cognitive step of these mappings from model features to abstraction layers, the maintainers implements modifications to files and modules in each layer.
blocks.zh:
维护者首先分析新引入的模型特性,并确定他们如何将图像映射到引擎的抽象级别和模块上.
如图3(a)中将Quen3.5-2B(Team,2026年)映射到MNN(Lv等人,2022年)的例子所示,新的聊天-模板格式或多模式设置(例如 " X<|im_start|> " 和输入视觉补丁大小)等变化被映射到输入级别;将视觉指数拉伸形状和数据类型等新的模型结构和拉伸合同映射到图表级别;必须把新引入的操作,例如FusedLinearAtenty(Yang等人,2025年)降低到操作人员级别的后端具体实施,例如CPUF使用Lineartyty及其ARM64近地天体的应用。
这些映射从模型特征到抽象层的认知步骤后,维护者对每个层的文件和模块进行修改.

blocks.en:
Maintainers’ implementation loop is an iterative host–device verify-debug loop.
As shown in Figure 3(b) , they first modify on host across Python, C/C++, assembly, or backend specific code, then cross-compile it using the corresponding toolchains, such as the Android NDK, Vulkan toolchain, or QNN SDK.
The resulting binaries and model artifacts are deployed to the target phone through Android Debug Bridge (ADB) for execution, after which logs, outputs, and other runtime artifacts are collected back on the host for verification.
If any stage fails, maintainers trace the observed error back to the responsible implementation, revise the code, and repeat the coding–build–deploy–execute–verify cycle until all required checks pass.
blocks.zh:
维护者执行循环是一个迭代主机 - device 校验 -debug 循环 。
如图3(b)所示,它们首先在主机上修改横跨Python,C/C++,组装,或后端特定代码,然后使用相应的工具链交叉编译,如Android NDK,Vulkan工具链,或QNN SDK.
由此产生的二进制和模型文物通过Android Debug Bridge(ADB)部署到目标手机上执行,之后日志,输出,以及其他运行时间文物被收集到主机上进行验证.
如果任何阶段失败, 维护者会将观察到的错误追溯到负责的执行, 修改代码, 重复编码 - 构建 - 部署 - 执行 - 验证周期, 直到所有必要的检查通过 。

blocks.zh: (a) 实例:将Quen3.5-2B(Team,2026年)特征映射到MNN(Lv等人,2022年)抽象层。

blocks.en: 2.3. Agent for Systems
blocks.zh: 2.3. 系统代理

blocks.en:
To alleviate the substantial human effort in model enablement, agentizing the workflow is a natural direction.
Existing works have developed complementary capabilities for software engineering: general-purpose end-to-end coding agents directly solve development tasks through iterative code modification and execution, while code-analysis tools and agents enhance end-to-end coding agents with repository representations, modification localization, and edit plans, and debugging agents augment them with failures diagnosis and generate corrective feedback.
However, these capabilities do not directly resolve the challenges of inference-engine model enablement.
blocks.zh:
为了减轻人力在模型赋能方面的大量努力,使工作流程具有代理作用是一个自然的方向。
现有作品发展了软件工程的互补能力:通用端对端编码代理通过迭代代码修改和执行直接解决开发任务,而代码分析工具和代理则用寄存器表示增强端对端编码代理,修改本地化,并编辑计划,调试代理则通过故障诊断和生成纠正反馈来增强它们.
然而,这些能力并不能直接解决推论引擎模型赋能的挑战。

blocks.en:
CodeAgent ( Zhang et al., 2024a ) , SWE-Agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , and OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025b ) provide end-to-end workflows integrating repository navigation, code modification, execution, and iterative feedback.
Recent systems efforts such as SYSSPEC ( Liu et al., 2026 ) and ECO ( Lin et al., 2026 ) further incorporate domain-specific abstractions and production constraints into LLM-driven system automation.
However, these approaches still do not target inference-engine model enablement as an end-to-end task: they neither expose engine hierarchies as first-class knowledge nor provide dedicated host–device verification and debugging procedures across heterogeneous hardware backends.
blocks.zh:
代码代理(Zhang等人,2024a),SWE代理(Yang等人,2024年),OpenHands(Wang等人,2025b)提供端到端的工作流程,整合寄存器导航,代码修改,执行,以及迭代反馈.
最近的系统努力,如SYSSPEC(刘等人,2026年)和ECO(林等人,2026年)进一步将特定域的抽象和生产限制纳入LLM驱动的系统自动化.
然而,这些方法仍然没有将推论-引擎模型的赋能作为一种端到端的任务:既未将引擎等级作为头等知识加以曝光,也未提供各种硬件后端的专用主机-设备验证和调试程序。

blocks.en:
CodeGraph ( McHenry, 2026 ) and LocAgent ( Chen et al., 2025 ) improve repository representation and localization, CodePlan ( Bairi et al., 2024 ) plans coordinated repository-wide edits, and AutoCodeRover ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) combines program-structure-aware search with fault localization.
However, these methods primarily organize knowledge around code-level structures such as files, symbols, functions, and AST or dependency relations.
They do not explicitly model how these entities map onto inference-engine abstraction layers, making cross-layer dependencies, wrong-layer localization, and structurally distant but semantically coupled modifications difficult to reason about.
blocks.zh:
CodeGraph(McHenry,2026年)和LocAgent(Chen等人,2025年)改进了寄存器的代表和本地化,CodePlan(Bairi等人,2024年)计划协调全寄存器的编辑,AutoCodeRover(Zhang等人,2024年b)将程序结构意识搜索与故障本地化相结合.
然而,这些方法主要围绕文件,符号,函数,AST或依赖关系等代码级结构组织知识.
它们没有明确模拟这些实体如何映射到推论-引擎抽象层,使得跨层依赖性,错误的层次本地化,以及结构上遥远但精密结合的修改难以解释.

blocks.en:
AgenTracer ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) attributes failures to responsible agents and trajectory steps, while AgentDebug ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) identifies root causes and provides corrective feedback for recovery.
Such approaches improve failure analysis, but remain largely centered on agent trajectories or host-side program feedback.
Model enablement instead requires cross-language, cross-compilation debugging across host preparation, device deployment, and heterogeneous XPU execution, where failures must be traced from device-side observations back to the responsible host-side implementation.
blocks.zh:
AgenTracher(Zhang等人,2026年)将故障归结为负责任的代理和轨迹步骤,而Agent Debug(Zhu等人,2025年)则确定了根源,并为恢复提供了纠正反馈.
这种方法改进了故障分析,但仍在很大程度上以代理轨迹或主机侧程序反馈为中心.
模型启用则需要跨语言,跨编译调试,跨主机准备,设备部署,和异构的XPU执行,其中失败必须追溯到设备侧观测回负责的主机侧执行.

blocks.en: 3. Case Studies and Key Insights
blocks.zh: 3个 案例研究和关键洞察

blocks.en: 3.1. Characterizing Agent Failures
blocks.zh: 3.1. 描述代理失败

blocks.en:
To understand the limitations of existing coding agents for on-device LLM model enablement, we conduct motivating case studies on three representative engine–backend pairs: MNN–CPU, llama.cpp–Vulkan, and ExecuTorch–QNN, with MiniCPM-V 4.6 as the target model.
We evaluate representative repository-level coding agents, including SWE-Agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , CodePlan ( Bairi et al., 2024 ) , OpenCode ( OpenCode Contributors, 2026 ) , Codex, and CodeGraph ( McHenry, 2026 ) + OpenCode + AgenTracer ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
The evaluated agents use their corresponding backbone models: DeepSeek-V4-Flash for open-source agent frameworks and GPT-5.6-Sol for Codex ( OpenAI, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
为了了解LLM 模型上的现有编码剂的局限性,我们针对三个具有代表性的引擎-后端对:MNN-CPU、lama.cpp-Vulkan和ExecuTorch–QNN, 以MiniCPM-V 4.6为目标模型。
我们评价有代表性的寄存层编码剂,包括SWE-Agent(杨等人,2024年),OpenHands(王等人,2025年b),CodePlan(Bairi等人,2024年),OpenCode(OpenCode贡献者,2026年),Codex,以及CodeGraph(麦克亨利,2026年)+OpenCode + AgenTracher(张等人,2026年).
被评价的代理人使用相应的骨干模型: DeepSeek-V4-Flash用于开源代理框架,GPT-5.6-Sol用于Codex(OpenAI,2026).

blocks.en:
Across these cases, existing agents demonstrate promising capability in repository exploration and local code modification, but rarely complete the entire model enablement workflow from model adaptation to validated on-device execution.
Across 18 test cases (6 agents × \times 3 representative engine–backend pairs), only 1 attempt successfully completes end-to-end model enablement.
The remaining 17 attempts fail at different stages, including cross-layer implementation, backend integration, and device-grounded verification.
Notably, the only successful case, OpenCode on MNN–CPU, supports the CPU backend, which has a simpler lowering and compilation stack than GPU/NPU.
These observations motivate a systematic categorization of agent failures.
blocks.zh:
在这些案例中,现有代理人在仓库勘探和本地代码修改方面表现出有希望的能力,但很少完成整个模型的启用工作流程,从模型改造到验证的安装执行。
在18个测试案例(6个代理 ×\times 3 代表性引擎 – 后端对)中,只有1个尝试成功完成端对端模型的启用.
其余17项尝试在不同阶段都失败,包括跨层执行、后端集成和基于设备的核查。
值得注意的是,唯一成功的案例是MNN-CPU上的OpenCode,支持CPU后端,它比GPU/NPU有一个更简单的降低和编译堆栈.
这些意见促使对代理故障进行系统分类。

blocks.en: Table 2. Representative failure cases of existing coding agents during on-device LLM model enablement.
blocks.zh: 图表 2. 具有代表性的在LLM模型启用期间现有编码剂的故障案例。

blocks.en:
We summarize representative failure cases of existing coding agents in Table 2 .
Although the failures occur at different stages and across different engine–backend pairs, they exhibit two recurring patterns.
First, agents frequently identify and modify locally relevant components but fail to recover the complete implementation scope required by a new model feature.
For example, CodePlan on MNN–CPU modified model-related configuration paths but missed the dependent vision and runtime implementations, while SWE-Agent modified model components without propagating changes across export and execution paths.
Second, agents often achieve intermediate host-side progress but fail to complete hardware-grounded validation.
For example, OpenCode and OpenHands on llama.cpp–Vulkan reached host-side adaptation but failed to establish the complete Vulkan execution workflow, while Codex prematurely stopped after an incomplete build state without reaching device validation.
These failure patterns indicate that reliable model enablement requires both engine-level understanding across abstraction layers and hardware-grounded verification capabilities.
blocks.zh:
我们总结表2中现有编码剂的代表性故障案例。
虽然失败发生在不同的阶段和不同的引擎-后端对之间,但它们表现出两种反复出现的模式。
首先,代理人经常识别和修改当地相关的组件,但未能恢复新的模型特征所要求的完整实施范围。
例如,MNN-CPU上的代码计划修改了模型相关的配置路径,但错过了依赖的愿景和运行时间执行,而SWE-Agent修改了模型组件,而没有在导出和执行路径中宣传变化.
第二,代理经常实现中间主机侧式进度,但未能完成基于硬件的验证.
例如,在llama.cpp–Vulkan上的OpenCode和OpenHands达到了主机侧修改,但未能建立完整的Vulkan执行工作流程,而Codex在未达到设备验证的构建状态不完整后过早停止.
这些故障模式表明,可靠的模型赋能既需要引擎层对抽象层的理解,也需要硬件基础的核查能力.

blocks.en: 3.2. Key Insights
blocks.zh: 3.2. 关键见解

blocks.en: The observed failures reveal two fundamental requirements for reliable agentic model enablement: global understanding of inference-engine abstractions and stable hardware-grounded verification workflows.
blocks.zh: 所观察到的失败揭示了可靠的代理模型赋能的两个基本要求:全球对推论-引擎抽象的理解和稳定的基于硬件的核查工作流程.

blocks.en:
Missing implementations and premature exits often stem from agents lacking a global view of the inference engine organization.
Without understanding the responsibilities and dependencies of different abstraction layers, agents may treat locally discovered code paths as the complete implementation scope and overlook required modifications elsewhere.
Therefore, agents require explicit hierarchy-aware engine knowledge to map model features to affected layers, recover complete modification scopes, and guide cross-layer implementation.
blocks.zh:
缺乏执行和过早退出往往是因为缺乏对推论引擎组织的全球观点。
在不理解不同抽象层的责任和依赖性的情况下,代理人可能会将当地发现的代码路径视为完整的执行范围,而忽略其他地方所需的修改。
因此,代理人需要明确的分级意识引擎知识,将模型特征映射到受影响的层,恢复完整的修改范围,并指导跨层执行.

blocks.en:
Hardware-aware debugging is challenging not only because device execution is heterogeneous, but also because the verification path itself may be unstable when enabling previously unsupported models.
Agents that directly debug unsupported models must simultaneously resolve model adaptation issues and uncertain build, deployment, and validation workflows, making failures difficult to attribute.
Therefore, reliable enablement requires pre-constructed and validated build, test, and debugging workflows from already supported models, which provide stable hardware-grounded feedback for subsequent model adaptation.
blocks.zh:
硬件意识调试具有挑战性,不仅因为设备执行是多种多样的,而且因为验证路径本身在启用先前不支持的模型时可能不稳定.
直接调试不支持模型的代理必须同时解决模型适应问题和不确定的构建,部署,验证工作流程,使失败难以归属.
因此,可靠的赋能需要预先构建和验证的构建,测试,调试来自已经支持的模型的工作流程,这些工作流程为随后的模型适应提供了稳定的硬件基础反馈.

blocks.en: 4. System Design
blocks.zh: 4. 系统设计

blocks.en: 4.1. System Overview
blocks.zh: 4.1. 系统概览

blocks.en: Guided by the two key insights, EngineAgent augments general-purpose coding agents with two capabilities: engine-hierarchy-aware understanding for complete cross-layer implementation and hardware-aware debugging and verification for reliable on-device validation. These capabilities support three complementary agent roles: a builder that implements model support, a debugger that diagnoses failures, and an independent auditor that challenges implementation completeness and correctness.
blocks.zh: 在两个关键见解的指导下,EngineAgent增强通用编码剂,具有两种能力:对完全跨层执行的引擎-等级-意识的理解和对硬件-意识的调试与验证,以可靠地进行安装验证. 这些能力支持三个相辅相成的代理角色:一个执行模型支持的构建者,一个诊断失败的调试者,以及一个挑战执行完整性和正确性的独立审计员.

blocks.en:
Following Insight 1, EngineAgent equips agents with a model-agnostic engine hierarchy knowledge index (§ 5 ).
The index connects engine abstractions to concrete code entities and exposes dependencies across export, runtime, and backend layers. It guides the builder in mapping new model features to the required modification scope and provides the auditor with structural context for identifying omitted implementations. Following Insight 2, EngineAgent equips agents with reusable hardware-aware verify-debug skills (§ 4.3 ). Before a new model arrives, construction agents establish and validate backend-specific build, deployment, testing, and debugging workflows using already supported models. These skills provide the builder with self-validation procedures, the debugger with diagnostic guidance, and the auditor with executable checks, reducing uncertainty in the verification path during new-model adaptation.
blocks.zh:
继"透视1"之后,"引擎代理"为代理机配备了模型-不可知的引擎等级知识指数(§5).

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 4 , both capabilities are prepared before model release and reused in the model-specific multi-agent main loop (§ 4.4 ). When a new model arrives, the builder compares its architecture with supported models, maps the differences onto the hierarchy index, and implements layer-wise modifications. The auditor checks each completed layer, while the debugger uses the validated host–device workflows to diagnose failures and guide revisions. The loop continues until the implementation passes both layer-wise checks and end-to-end device validation.

blocks.en: 4.2. Hierarchy-Aware Engine Understanding
blocks.zh: 4.2. 分级-智能发动机理解

blocks.en: Figure 5. CodeGraph ( McHenry, 2026 ) only captures syntactic structures rather than hierarchical understandin gs. Extracted relations in MNN CodeGraph as an example are illustrated on the left.
blocks.zh: 图 5. CodeGraph(McHenry,2026年)只捕捉合成结构,而不是层次理解in gs. MNN CodeGraph中摘录的关系作为例子在左侧被说明.

blocks.en:
For a fixed engine snapshot, prior work CodeGraph ( McHenry, 2026 ) provides a language-agnostic canonical graph of files, symbols, and typed static relations, including imports, calls, references, and instantiations, as illustrated in Figure 5 .
However, it captures only how code entities are structurally connected, without revealing the abstract knowledge of engine hierarchical design.
blocks.zh:
对于固定引擎快照,如图5所示,先前的工作代码Graph(McHenry, 2026)提供了文件,符号和打入的静态关系的语言-不可知的卡通图,包括导入,调用,引用和即时.
然而,它只捕捉代码实体如何在结构上连接,而没有揭示引擎分级设计的抽象知识.

blocks.en:
To encounter this, EngineAgent defines a nine-layer hierarchy based on the design abstraction of on-device LLM engines and automatically constructs a hierarchy-aware index by semantically lifting the CodeGraph representation of the engine into our pre-defined hierarchy.
In this way, engine abstractions are explicitly represented as structured semantic subgraph views over the original CodeGraph, extending syntactic relations to system-level understanding.
blocks.zh:
要遇到这一点,EngineAgent根据在device LLM引擎上的设计抽象定义了九层阶梯,并通过将引擎的CodeGraph表示法逐步提升到我们预先定义的阶梯中来自动构建一个阶梯意识指数.
这样,引擎抽象在原CodeGraph上被明确表现为结构化的语义子图视图,将合成关系扩展到系统层面的理解.

blocks.en:
As discussed in Section 2.1 , on-device LLM engines follow a two-stage workflow, where each stage contains three-level: input level, graph-level, and operator-level.
In order to better help agents understand the engine hierarchy, we further divide the three levels into nine layers, including ① chat template and tokenization and ② multimodal preprocessing layers on input level; ③ model configuration, ④ I/O tensor contracts, ⑤ module mapping, ⑥ weight sharing and KV sharing layers on graph level; and ⑦ attention and KV cache, ⑧ operator wrapping, and ⑨ operator kernel layers on operator level.
Specifically, the offline-export has eight of these layers (L1–L8), spanning the export or compilation of each layer.
The execution-stage, on the other hand, contains all nine abstraction layers (L1–L9), extending the export-stage hierarchy with an additional L9 layer for hardware-specific kernels, covering the parsing and execution of exported artifacts on each layer.
For each abstraction layer, engine may have one or more instantiations: model-related layers (L3/L4) distinguish text-backbone and multimodal instantiations, while backend-dependent layers (offline L7–L8 and runtime L7–L9) are instantiated separately for CPU, Vulkan, OpenCL, and QNN when applicable.
We define these intra-layer substructures as layer instantiations.
By defining this layered hierarchy in prompt, EngineAgent agentically construct a knowledge index from the raw CodeGraph to incorporate these knowledge into graph structures.
blocks.zh:
如第2.1节所述,安装的LLM引擎遵循两个阶段的工作流程,每个阶段包含三个层次:输入层次、图表层次和操作人员层次。
为了更好帮助代理者了解引擎层级,我们进一步将三个级别分为9层,包括1个聊天模板和标语化以及2个输入级的多式联运预处理层;3个模型配置,4个I/O拉诺合同,5个模块映射,6个重量共享和KV共享层在图层;7个注意力和KV缓存,8个操作员包装,9个操作员内核层在操作员级.
具体而言,离线出口有八层(L1-L8),跨越每层的导出或汇编。
另一方面,执行阶段包含所有9个抽象层(L1-L9),扩展出口阶段的层次,为硬件特定内核增加一个L9层,涵盖每个层上输出文物的剖析和执行.
对于每个抽象层,引擎可能有一个或多个即时:模型相关层(L3/L4)区分文本背骨和多式联运即时,而后端依赖层(离线L7–L8和运行时间L7–L9)则在适用的情况下分别对CPU,Vulkan,OpenCL和QNN进行即时.
我们把这些层内亚结构定义为层内即时结构.
通过迅速定义这种分层的等级,Engine Agent从原始代码Graph中构建一个知识指数,将这些知识融入图表结构.

blocks.en:
EngineAgent constructs the hierarchy index as a nested graph structure following the predefined abstraction hierarchy.
The construction agent first divides the raw CodeGraph into export and execution stage subgraphs and then sequentially builds abstraction-layer subgraphs within each stage.
For each layer, the agent builds semantic understanding from the predefined hierarchy knowledge and repository evidence, selects representative code entities as seeds, and initializes the subgraph.
The subgraph is then expanded from these seeds by traversing CodeGraph relations and incorporating entities supported by additional evidence.
To improve reliability, EngineAgent separates semantic hierarchy attribution from raw graph construction, where static relation errors are checked independently while layer membership is determined through semantic evidence.
After construction, the indexing agent performs self-review and a read-only auditor validates the completeness and grounding of the generated subgraphs.
The resulting index provides multiple semantic views of the code entity graph across stages, abstraction layers, and instantiations.
By mapping engine functional abstractions onto concrete code entities, it bridges the gap between repository structure and engine organization, enabling agents to understand how high-level functionalities are realized by specific modules.
blocks.zh:
EngineAgent按照预先定义的抽象结构结构将等级索引构建为嵌入式图结构.
建筑代理首先将原始的CodeGraph分为导出和执行阶段子图,然后在每个阶段内依次构建抽象层子图.
对于每一层,代理从预定义的等级知识和寄存证据中构建语义理解,选择具有代表性的代码实体作为种子,并初始化子图.
然后通过翻转CodeGraph关系和吸收有额外证据支持的实体来从这些种子中扩展子图.
为了提高可靠性,EngineAgent将语义等级归属与原始图构造区分开来,其中静态关系错误通过独立检查,而层成员通过语义证据确定.
构建后,索引代理机构进行自我审查,只读审计员验证生成的子图的完整性和落地性.
由此产生的索引提供了代码实体图跨阶段,抽象层,以及即时的多个语义视图.
通过将引擎功能抽象图映射到具体代码实体上,可以弥合寄存器结构与引擎组织之间的空白,使代理能够理解如何通过特定模块实现高层次功能.

blocks.en: Figure 6. Hierarchy-aware engine modeling for MNN. The original CodeGraph (center) is organized into abstraction-layer subgraphs for export (top, L1–L8) and execution (bottom, L1–L9), with layer definitions shown on the left. Colored subgraphs group code entities by engine responsibility, while gray edges indicate cross-layer dependencies.
blocks.zh: 图 6. MNN的分级意识发动机建模. 最初的CodeGraph(中心)被组织成抽象层子图,用于导出(top,L1-L8)和执行(bottom,L1-L9),图层定义显示在左侧. 彩色子图组代码实体通过引擎责任,而灰色边缘则表示跨层的依赖性.

blocks.en:
Figure 6 visualizes the hierarchy-aware graph index constructed for MNN.
The middle panel shows the original CodeGraph, where files and symbols are connected only through static code relations.
After semantic lifting, EngineAgent reorganizes these entities into export- and execution-stage subgraphs and further into abstraction-layer subgraphs.
The resulting layers exhibit clear semantic coherence by grouping code entities according to their engine responsibilities.
blocks.zh:
图6可视化了为MNN构建的分级感知图形索引.
中间面板显示原始的CodeGraph,其中文件和符号只能通过静态代码关系连接.
语义提升后,EngineAgent将这些实体重组为输出和执行阶段子图,并进一步重组为抽象层子图.
由此形成的层通过按照代码实体的引擎责任分组,表现出明显的语义一致性.

blocks.en: Figure 7. Instantiation subgraphs within MNN’s execution-stage hierarchy, exposing modality- and backend-specific code structures within each layer.
blocks.zh: 图 7. MNN执行阶段的层次结构内的证明子图,揭示每一层内模式和后端特定代码结构。

blocks.en:
Abstraction-layer subgraphs with multiple concrete realizations are further refined into subordinate instantiation subgraphs .
As shown in Figure 7 , MNN’s L3 separates backbone and multimodal implementations, while L8 branches into CPU, Vulkan, OpenCL, and QNN implementations with distinct backend-specific code paths.
These instantiation subgraphs expose how the same engine abstraction is realized differently across modalities and hardware backends.
blocks.zh:
具有多重具体实现的抽象层子图被进一步细化为从属的即时化子图 .
如图7所示,MNN的L3将骨干执行和多式联运执行分开,而L8分支则分为CPU,Vulkan,OpenCL,和QNN执行,并有明显的后端专用代码路径.
这些即时化子图揭示了不同模式和硬件后端如何不同地实现相同的引擎抽象.

blocks.en:
For each new commit, EngineAgent maps added, removed, and modified code entities onto the existing hierarchy-aware graph index and identifies the affected stage, abstraction-layer, and instantiation subgraphs.
Only these subgraphs and their immediate dependency neighborhoods are re-examined to update entity attribution, execution paths, and cross-layer relations, while unaffected subgraphs are directly reused.
Only when a commit introduces major structural changes, or repeated incremental updates cause excessive accumulated drift, EngineAgent triggers a hierarchy-aware index reconstruction.
Thus, incremental updates of the pre-constructed model-agnostic index incur only modest overhead.
blocks.zh:
对于每一个新的承诺,EngineAgent映射会将代码实体添加,删除,并修改到现有的分级意识图索引中,并识别受影响的阶段,抽象层,以及即时子图.
只有这些子图及其直接的依赖邻里被重新审查,以更新实体归属,执行路径,以及跨层关系,而未受影响的子图则直接被重新使用.
只有当一个承诺引入了重大的结构变化,或者重复的递增更新导致过度累积漂移时,EngineAgent触发了分级意识指数重建.
因此,对预先构建的模型不可知指数进行增量更新仅产生少量间接费用。

blocks.en: 4.3. Host–Device Debugging and Verification Skills
blocks.zh: 4.3. 主机-调试和核查技能

blocks.en:
Model enablement requires not only modifying the correct engine layers, but also repeatedly building, deploying, executing, and diagnosing the resulting implementation on real devices.
To support reliable hardware-aware verify-debug loop, EngineAgent agentically constructs dedicated verify-debug skills around these host–device workflows.
These procedures are largely engine and backend specific, yet remain reusable across subsequent new model enablements.
blocks.zh:
模型赋能不仅需要修改正确的引擎层,而且需要反复建设,部署,执行,并诊断由此产生的在真设备上的执行.
为了支持可靠的硬件意识验证-调试循环,Engine Agent代理围绕这些主机–调试工作流程构建专用的校验-调试技能.
这些程序大多是发动机和后端专用程序,但在后来的新模型中仍然可以重复使用。

blocks.en: To provide agents with procedural knowledge for backend-specific building, verification, and failure diagnosis, EngineAgent agentically constructs build skills , unit tests , and few-shot debug skills before individual model-enablement tasks.
blocks.zh: 为了向特工提供针对后端的建筑、核查和故障诊断的程序知识,Engine Agent代理构建在单个模型可操作任务之前建立技能、单元测试和几发调试技能。

blocks.en: Figure 8. Examples of generated unit tests and debug skills for MNN-CPU execution stage by Deepseek-V4-Flash.
blocks.zh: 图 8. Deepseek-V4-Flash为 MNN-CPU 执行阶段生成单元测试和调试技能的例子。

blocks.en:
Build skills organize information scattered across documentation, build scripts, and repository instructions into two executable workflows: model conversion/export and execution runner build and deployment.
Rather than merely summarizing documentation, the construction agent explores the relevant scripts and commands and validates the resulting workflow by exporting and executing an already supported model on the real device.
blocks.zh:
将技能组织起来,将分散在文档中的信息组织起来,将脚本建立起来,并将寄存指令编成两个可执行的工作流程:模型转换/导出和执行跑者构建和部署.
施工代理商不单单对文档进行总结,而是探索相关的脚本和命令,并通过在真实设备上输出和执行一个已经得到支持的模型来验证由此产生的工作流程.

blocks.en:
Besides, unit tests and few-shot debug skills are further constructed following the layer and instantiation division defined in hierarchy-aware graph index.
For the export stage, it traverses L1–L8 in order and builds tests around the observable input/output contracts of each abstraction layer, from preprocessing and model configuration to module mapping and operator lowering.
For the execution stage, it similarly traverses L1–L9, extending validation through runtime operators and hardware-specific kernels.
When a layer contains multiple instantiations, tests are constructed separately for the corresponding modality or backend branches.
Figure 8 illustrate the example of generated skills for MNN-CPU execution stage.
These generated skills check and verify the outputs and functionality of each layer’s modules.
Together, these tests form a progressive validation chain, allowing failures to be localized to the earliest layer whose contract is violated rather than only being observed at end-to-end execution.
During this construction process, successful diagnostic procedures, characteristic failure symptoms, and corresponding recovery actions are summarized into few-shot debug skills associated with their abstraction layers and hardware backends.
blocks.zh:
此外,单元测试和几发调试技能也按照分层-意识图索引定义的层和即时分层进一步构建.
在出口阶段,它通过L1-L8进行测试,围绕每个抽象层的可观察输入/输出合同,从预处理和模型配置到模块绘图和操作员降低。
对于执行阶段,它同样通过运行时运算符和硬件专用内核进行扩展验证.
当一层包含多个即时现象时,为相应的模式或后端分支分别构建测试.
图8说明了为MNN-CPU执行阶段创造技能的例子。
这些结果产生了技能检查和核实各层模块的产出和功能。
这些测试共同构成了一个渐进的验证链,允许失败被本地化到合同被违反的最早层,而不仅仅是在端到端执行时被观察到.
在这一构建过程中,成功的诊断程序,特征性故障症状,以及相应的恢复动作被总结为与其抽象层和硬件后端相关的几发调试技能.

blocks.en:
Prebuilt hardware aware verify-debug skills are updated using the same incremental principle as engine knowledge index updates.
Changes to build scripts, documentation, backend implementations, or toolchain configurations invalidate only their associated build skills, unit tests, and few-shot debug skills.
These affected artifacts are re-examined and revalidated, including replaying changed build or deployment workflows with an already supported model when necessary, while retaining unaffected artifacts.
A complete reconstruction is performed only when the corresponding backend workflow or toolchain undergoes substantial changes.
blocks.zh:
预建硬件意识校验-调试技能采用与引擎知识指数更新相同的增量原理进行更新.
用于构建脚本,文档,后端执行的修改,或工具链配置仅使其关联的构建技能,单元测试,以及几发调试技能无效.
对这些受到影响的文物进行重新审查和重新鉴定,包括在必要时用已经支持的模型重新播放已改变的建筑或部署工作流程,同时保留未受影响的文物。
只有当相应的后端工作流程或工具链发生实质性变化时,才进行完整的重建.

blocks.en: 4.4. Model-Specific Multi-Agent Main Loop
blocks.zh: 4.4 特定型号的多代理主循环

blocks.en:
When a new model arrives, EngineAgent uses the prebuilt hierarchy index and debug skills to modify the target engine for a specified XPU backend.
This process is illustrated in Figure 4 .
EngineAgent instantiates three model-specific agents from the pre-constructed artifacts: a builder agent for implementation, a debugger agent for debugging reinforcement, and an independent auditor agent for red-team verification.
blocks.zh:
当一个新的模型到达时,EngineAgent使用预建的层次索引和调试技能来修改指定的XPU后端的目标引擎.
图4说明了这一进程。

blocks.en:
The builder agent first performs a difference analysis against the engine’s supported model set constructed during pre-enablement to identify the most similar reference models.
The architectural differences between the reference and new models are mapped onto the hierarchy-aware graph index to derive layer-wise modification plans.
The builder then implements these tasks sequentially across abstraction layers.
For each layer, the builder retrieves relevant hierarchy knowledge and hardware-aware build skills, unit tests, and few-shot debug skills to guide implementation and self-validation.
blocks.zh:
建造者代理首先对发动机在预开发期间建造的辅助模型组进行差异分析,以确定最相似的参考模型.
参考模型和新模型之间的建筑差异被映射到分层-感知图表指数上,以得出分层修改计划.
构建者然后在抽象层之间依次执行这些任务.
对于每一层,建设者都会检索相关的等级知识和硬件意识构建技能,单元测试,以及几发调试技能,以指导执行和自我验证.

blocks.en:
The debugger agent reinforces the builder when failures occur or progress becomes blocked.
Given the current abstraction layer, backend, execution logs, and validation results, it retrieves corresponding debugging skills, reproduces relevant workflows when necessary, and provides targeted diagnostic evidence and recovery suggestions.
By leveraging pre-constructed debug skills, the debugger avoids repeatedly exploring unstable verification paths during enablement.
blocks.zh:
调试器在失败发生或进度受阻时会强化构建器.
鉴于目前的抽象层,后端,执行日志,以及验证结果,它检索相应的调试技能,必要时复制相关的工作流程,并提供有针对性的诊断证据和恢复建议.
通过利用预先构建的调试技能,调试者避免在启用时反复探索不稳定的核查路径.

blocks.en:
The auditor agent independently evaluates the builder’s implementation as a red-team verifier.
After each abstraction layer is completed, it executes the corresponding pre-constructed unit tests and checks whether the implementation satisfies layer-specific requirements.
If validation fails, the auditor returns the earliest failing layer and device-side evidence for subsequent debugging.
After all layers pass, the auditor performs end-to-end validation covering model export, deployment, and on-device execution before approving the implementation.
blocks.zh:
审计代理人独立地评价建筑商作为红队核查员的执行情况。
每个抽象层完成后,它执行相应的预构单元测试,并检查执行是否满足了层特异性要求.
如果验证失败,审计员会返回最早的故障层和设备侧证据,以便随后调试.
审计师经过所有各层后,在核准实施之前,进行端到端的验证,包括模型导出、部署和即时执行。

blocks.en:
Together, these agents form an iterative implementation–verification loop.
The builder proposes modifications, the auditor challenges their correctness, and the debugger provides targeted recovery when failures occur.
The loop continues until all layer-wise checks and end-to-end device validation pass.
Finally, the auditor-approved implementation is submitted to a rule-based non-agentic system verifier, which compares output logits against host-side PyTorch references and rejects implementations whose deviations exceed a predefined numerical tolerance.
blocks.zh:
这些代理人共同构成一个迭代执行-验证循环.
建设者提出修改,审计师质疑其正确性,调试者在发生故障时提供有针对性的回收.
循环一直持续到所有层次的检查和端到端设备验证通过.
最后,审计员核准的执行提交给一个基于规则的非代理系统核查员,该核查员将输出记录与主机侧 PyTorch 引用进行比较,并拒绝其偏离超过预定义的数字容忍度的执行。

blocks.en: 5. Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.五. 评价

blocks.en: 5.1. Benchmark Design
blocks.zh: 5.1. 基准设计

blocks.en:
To evaluate the effectiveness of agentic systems for on-device LLM model enablement, we construct a benchmark comprising 12 tasks across four representative engine–backend pairs and three recent mobile LLMs: Qwen3.5-2B ( Team, 2026 ) , Gemma4-E2B-it ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) , and MiniCPM-V 4.6 ( OpenBMB, 2026 ) .
Each task requires enabling one target model on one engine–backend pair, covering diverse model architectures and heterogeneous CPU, GPU, and NPU execution paths.
blocks.zh:
为了评价设备LLM模型启用的代理系统的有效性,我们构建了一个基准,由四个具有代表性的引擎(后端对)和三个最近移动的LLMs(Quen3.5-2B(Team, 2026)),Gemma4-E2B-it(Google DeepMind, 2026)和MiniCPM-V 4.6(OpenBMB, 2026)的12项任务组成。
每个任务都需要在一个引擎-后端对上启用一个目标模型,涵盖不同的模型架构和不同的CPU,GPU,和NPU执行路径.

blocks.en:
The benchmark covers four representative mobile engine–backend pairs: • MNN + CPU, • llama.cpp + Vulkan, • MLC-LLM + OpenCL, • ExecuTorch + QNN. These pairs span substantially different execution stacks and hardware abstractions.
MNN + CPU ( Lv et al., 2022 ) represents a native CPU execution path with direct operator and kernel implementations; llama.cpp + Vulkan ( Gerganov, 2026 ) represents explicit GPU execution through Vulkan kernels and backend dispatch; MLC-LLM + OpenCL ( MLC team, 2023 ) captures a compiler-based deployment workflow targeting mobile GPUs; and ExecuTorch + QNN ( Foundation, 2025 ) represents graph lowering and execution through a vendor-specific NPU backend.
Together, they cover CPU, GPU, and NPU execution as well as native, compiler-based, and accelerator-specific enablement workflows.
blocks.zh:
基准包括四个具有代表性的移动引擎-后端对: • MNN + CPU, • lama.cpp + Vulkan, • MLC-LLM + OpenCL, • ExecuTorch + QNN. 这些对子跨度相差很大的执行堆栈和硬件抽象.
MNN + CPU(Lv et al., 2022)代表一个具有直接操作员和内核执行的原生CPU执行路径;lama.cpp + Vulkan(Gerganov, 2026)代表通过Vulkan内核和后端发送的明确的GPU执行;MLC-LLLM + OpenCL(MLC team, 2023)捕获一个基于编译器的部署工作流程,针对移动GPU;ExecuTorch + QNN(Foundation, 2025)代表通过供应商专用的NPU后端进行图降级和执行.
它们共同覆盖CPU,GPU,和NPU执行以及基于原生,编译器,以及加速器特有的赋能工作流程.

blocks.en: MNN + CPU,
blocks.zh: MNN + CPU, (英语).

blocks.en: llama.cpp + Vulkan,
blocks.zh: 拉玛.cpp + Vulkan , (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: MLC-LLM + OpenCL,
blocks.zh: MLC-LLM + OpenCL,, (英语).

blocks.zh: ExecuTorch + QNN (英语).

blocks.en:
For each model–engine–backend pair, if the target model has already been supported, we reset the engine to the commit immediately preceding the support commit and ask the agent to reproduce the enablement from this pre-support state.
Under this setting, the agent is not allowed to access future commits or search the web for post-snapshot implementations.
If the target model is not yet supported by the corresponding engine–backend pair, we use the latest available engine snapshot and construct a forward-enable task.
Such tasks reflect realistic maintenance scenarios where no ground-truth support patch exists and success can only be determined through end-to-end validation.
Each benchmark task provides the agent with an engine repository snapshot, a target model checkpoint, the backend configuration, and validation scripts.
This setup requires the agent to solve the actual model-enablement problem rather than recover an existing implementation.
blocks.zh:
对于每个型号 - 引擎 - 后端对子, 如果目标型号已经被支持, 我们重新设置引擎到支持承诺之前的承诺, 请代理重现此预支持状态的赋能 。
在此设置下,代理商不得访问未来承诺或搜索网络进行snapshot后执行.
如果目标模型还没有相应的引擎-后端对支持,我们使用最新的可用引擎快照并构建一个可前进的任务.
这些任务反映了现实的维护情景,即不存在地面真实支持补丁,成功只能通过端到端验证来确定.
每个基准任务都为代理商提供引擎寄存器快照,目标模型检查点,后端配置,以及验证脚本.
这种设置要求代理人解决实际的模型可操作性问题,而不是恢复现有的执行.

blocks.en:
A task is considered successful only if the upgraded engine passes host compilation, device execution, and output-logit alignment checks verified by our evaluation program.
The evaluation program reproduces the provided build scripts to verify model export and runner cross-compilation, then deploys the generated artifacts to the target phone through ADB and checks that execution completes without errors.
It subsequently runs multiple on-device test cases covering all required modalities, collects the output logits, and compares them against host-side PyTorch reference results.
The implementation is accepted only when the logits agree with the reference outputs, with only negligible numerical drift attributed to hardware differences.
blocks.zh:
只有经过升级的引擎通过由我们的评价程序核实的宿主编译、设备执行和输出-记录对齐检查,一项任务才被认为是成功的。
评价程序复制了提供的构建脚本,以验证模型导出和跑者交叉编译,然后通过亚行向目标电话部署生成的文物,并检查执行完成时没有出错.
它随后运行了覆盖所有所需模式的多个在线设备测试案例,收集输出日志,并与主机侧PyTorch的参考结果进行比较.
只有当对数与参考产出一致时,才接受实施,因为硬件差异造成的数字漂移微不足道。

blocks.en: 5.2. Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.2. 实验设置

blocks.en:
We compare against four representative coding-agent baselines. SWE-Agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) represents repository-level autonomous software engineering, while OpenCode ( OpenCode Contributors, 2026 ) and Codex ( OpenAI, 2026 ) represent general-purpose coding agents.
We further construct a composite baseline, OpenCode + CodeGraph + AgenTracer , augmenting OpenCode with graph-based repository understanding ( McHenry, 2026 ) and trajectory-level failure diagnosis ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
Since coding agents frequently terminate prematurely on long-running enablement tasks without human continuation prompts, we enable the goal mode of Codex and attach a lightweight continuous-run trigger to the other baselines, which resumes the agents when the evaluator has not yet accepted the implementation as successful and the time limit has not been reached.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了四个有代表性的编码剂基线。 SWE-Agent(Yang等人,2024年)代表寄存器级自主软件工程,而OpenCode(OpenCode Controductions,2026年)和Codex(OpenAI,2026年)代表通用编码代理.
我们进一步构建了复合基线OpenCode + CodeGraph + AgenTracher ,通过基于图表的寄存器理解(McHenry, 2026)和轨迹级故障诊断(Zhang等人, 2026年)来增强OpenCode.
由于编码剂经常在没有人类延续的提示的情况下过早终止长期运行的赋能任务,所以我们启用了Codex的目标模式,并在其他基线上附加一个轻量级连续运行的触发器,当评价者尚未接受执行成功且时限尚未达到时,该启动器恢复.

blocks.en:
SWE-Agent, OpenCode, and OpenCode + CodeGraph + AgenTracer use the DeepSeek-V4-Flash API ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2026 ) , while Codex uses GPT-5.6 Sol ( Singh et al., 2026 ) .
We evaluate EngineAgent with both DeepSeek-V4-Flash and GPT-5.6 Sol.
This provides matched comparisons against both groups of baselines and separates the effectiveness of the EngineAgent harness from LLM API it calls.
blocks.zh:
SWE-Agent,OpenCode,以及OpenCode + CodeGraph + AgenTracher 使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash API(DeepSeek-AI等人,2026年),而Codex则使用GPT-5.6 Sol(Singh等人,2026年).
我们用DeepSeek-V4-Flash和GPT-5.6 Sol评估引擎代理。
这提供了与这两类基线的匹配比较,并且将引擎辅助装置的效能与它所称的LLM API区分开来。

blocks.en:
We primarily report end-to-end success rate , together with five stage-wise success rates : export, host text-only, host multimodal, device text-only, and device multimodal, to localize failures along the enablement pipeline.
A stage is counted as successful only when all associated evaluator checks described above pass. We also report average wall-clock time and average monetary cost per task. Each run is capped at five hours, with timeouts counted as five hours; monetary cost is measured by the total model-API usage incurred during the run.
blocks.zh:
我们主要报告端到端的成功率,以及五个阶段性的成功率:出口、仅主机文本、主机多式联运、只设备文本以及设备多式联运,以便将故障定位于赋能管道沿线。
只有当上述所有相关评价员检查通过时,才算一个阶段的成功。 我们还报告每项任务的平均时钟时间和平均货币费用。 每次运行的上限为5小时,超时计为5小时;货币成本按运行期间发生的模型-API使用总量计量.

blocks.en: 5.3. Overall Performance across Benchmark Cases
blocks.zh: 5.3. 基准案件的总体业绩

blocks.en: Table 3 summarizes performance across 12 model-enablement tasks. EngineAgent achieves 9/12 end-to-end successes (75%) with either DeepSeek-V4-Flash or GPT-5.6 Sol, substantially outperforming all baselines. The strongest baseline, Codex with GPT-5.6 Sol, succeeds on only 4/12 tasks (33.3%), while OpenCode and CodeGraph + OpenCode + AgentTracer each succeed on 1/12 and SWE-Agent on none.
blocks.zh: 表3汇总了12项示范性任务的业绩。 Engine Agent在DeepSeek-V4-Flash或GPT-5.6 Sol中取得了9/12的端对端成功(75%),大大超过所有基线。 最强的基线是带有GPT-5.6 Sol的Codex,只成功完成4/12任务(33.3%),而OpenCode和CodeGraph + OpenCode + Agent Tracer在1/12上各成功,SWE-Agent在0上成功.

blocks.en: Table 3. Overall model enablement performance across the 12 benchmark cases.
blocks.zh: 表3. 12个基准案例的总体模型赋能绩效。

blocks.en:
EngineAgent achieves higher success rate while using less time and lower model-API cost than the baselines.
With DeepSeek-V4-Flash, EngineAgent completes each task in 3.82 hours on average at a cost of $1.53, compared with 4.78–4.91 hours and $2.11–$2.44 for the corresponding baselines.
With GPT-5.6 Sol, EngineAgent averages 4.16 hours and $11.29 per task, compared with 4.82 hours and $14.90 for Codex.
blocks.zh:
EngineAgent在使用比基线少的时间和较低的模型-API成本的同时,实现了更高的成功率.
有了DeepSeek-V4-Flash,EngineAgent平均每3.82小时完成每项任务,费用为1.53美元,而相应的基线为4.78-4.91小时,2.11-2.44美元.
使用GPT-5.6 Sol,引擎代理平均为4.16小时,每个任务为11.29美元,而Codex则有4.82小时和14.90美元.

blocks.zh: 图表 4. 12个基准案例的分阶段启用模式成功。 (T:主机/设备上仅文本主干线成功率,MM:主机/设备上多模式成功率).

blocks.en: Table 4 shows where the performance gap emerges along the enablement pipeline. With DeepSeek-V4-Flash, EngineAgent achieves 10/12 successes in export and host-side text-only and multimodal execution, and 9/12 on both device-side paths. In contrast, DeepSeek-based baselines reach at most 4/12 at the host stage and fall to 0–1/12 on device. Adding CodeGraph and AgentTracer to OpenCode improves host-side multimodal success from 2/12 to 4/12, but device-side success remains 1/12, suggesting that stronger repository understanding alone is insufficient for hardware-grounded execution. With GPT-5.6 Sol, Codex reaches 6/12 on export and host text-only execution and 4/12 on multimodal execution, while EngineAgent still achieves 10/12 on host and 9/12 on device. Overall, EngineAgent’s advantage extends beyond finding the correct implementation to maintaining correctness through multimodal integration and host-to-device execution.
blocks.zh: 表4显示在输能管道沿线的性能差距。 随着DeepSeek-V4-Flash,EngineAgent在导出和主机侧文本和多模式执行上取得了10/12的成功,在两个设备侧路径上都取得了9/12的成功. 相比之下,基于DeepSeek的基线在主机阶段最多达到4/12,在设备上则下降到0–1/12. 将CodeGraph和AgentTracher添加到OpenCode中可以改善主机侧式多式联运成功率,从2/12提高到4/12,但设备侧式成功率仍为1/12,说明仅靠加强存储器的理解不足以实现硬件基于执行. 与GPT-5.6索尔, Codex在导出和主机文本执行上达到6/12,在多模式执行上达到4/12,而EngineAgent仍然在主机上达到10/12,在设备上达到9/12. 总体而言,引擎代理的优势不仅在于找到正确的执行方式,还在于通过多式联运和主机对设备的执行来保持正确性。

blocks.en: Figure 9. Failure breakdown across the 12 benchmark cases.
blocks.zh: 图 9. 12个基准案例的故障细目。

blocks.en:
Figure 9 breaks down failures across the 12 tasks. SWE-Agent and OpenCode each miss three required implementations and incur five graph-level failures, while Codex still fails in eight cases across all four categories.
In contrast, EngineAgent eliminates both missing-implementation and hardware deployment/verification failures, and reduces hardware-kernel failures to 1/12.
This suggests that hierarchy-aware knowledge helps recover the required implementation scope, while a stable build–verify–debug workflow prevents deployment failures and provides reliable feedback for hardware-specific debugging.
As a result, EngineAgent’s remaining three failures are limited to two graph-level and one hardware-kernel implementation failure.
blocks.zh:
图9分列了12项任务的失败情况。 SWE-Agent和OpenCode各错失了三个需要执行,并发生5个图级故障,而Codex在所有4个类别中仍有8个失败.
相比之下,GenardAgent同时消除了缺少执行和硬件部署/验证故障,将硬件内核故障减少到1/12.
这表明,分级认识的知识有助于恢复所需的执行范围,而稳定的构建-验证-调试工作流程可以防止部署失败,并为硬件特定的调试提供可靠的反馈.
因此,EngineAgent的其余三个故障仅限于两个图级和一个硬件内核执行失败.

blocks.en: 5.4. Breakdown Analysis By Cases
blocks.zh: 5.4. 按情况分列的分析

blocks.en:
The key challenge in enabling Qwen3.5-2B on llama.cpp-Vulkan is supporting the newly introduced Linear Attention operator on the Vulkan backend. As illustrated in Figure 10 , SWE-Agent fails at the graph-export stage because it overlooks an unsupported implementation required by the new operator. OpenCode, CodeGraph + OpenCode + AgentTracer, and Codex progress further but eventually fail when implementing the execution-stage Linear Attention kernel. In particular, these agents struggle to localize kernel-level implementation errors merely with their continuous end-to-end verification.
In contrast, EngineAgent exploits its hardware-aware build-test-debug skills and directly constructs unit tests for the Linear Attention kernel and iteratively debugs the implementation on device. This hardware-grounded verification loop enables EngineAgent to progressively localize and fix the implementation errors, ultimately completing the enablement in approximately 4.5 hours.
blocks.zh:
让 Quen3.5-2B 在 lama.cpp-Vulkan 上运行的关键挑战是支持 Vulkan 后端上新引入的 Linear 注意操作器. 如图10所示,SWE-Agent在图报出口阶段失败,因为它忽略了新运营商要求的不支持执行。 OpenCode,CodeGraph + OpenCode + Agent Tracer,和Codex进一步取得进展,但最终在实施执行阶段线性关注内核时失败. 特别是,这些代理人仅仅依靠连续的端到端核查,就难以将内核层面的执行错误本地化。
相比之下,Engine Agent则利用其硬件意识的构建-测试-调试技能,直接为线性关注内核构建单元测试,并迭代调试设备上的执行. 这种基于硬件的验证循环使Engine Agent能够逐渐定位并修复执行错误,最终在大约4.5小时内完成启用.

blocks.en: Figure 10. Progress Comparison of Agents enabling Qwen3.5-2B in llama.cpp-Vulkan.
blocks.zh: 图10. Lama.cpp-Vulkan中使 Quen3.5-2B 成为可能的代理物的进展比较。

blocks.en:
The key challenge in enabling MiniCPM-V 4.6 on ExecuTorch-QNN is to jointly modify the host-side offline QNN graph compilation and the online execution runtime.
As illustrated in Figure 11 , all baselines fail during export: they repeatedly modify and debug the graph and operator export paths, but eventually time out because each iteration incurs the high latency of offline QNN preparation.
In contrast, EngineAgent leverages its hierarchy-aware index to directly localize the required changes for the newly introduced window-attention vit_merger in the Python exporter, successfully exporting the model within two attempts and completing the enablement at last.
blocks.zh:
在ExecuTorch-QNN上实现MiniCPM-V 4.6的关键挑战是联合修改主机侧离线的QNN图编译和在线执行运行时间.
如图11所示,所有基线在导出过程中都会失败:它们会反复修改和调试图和运算符导出路径,但最终会暂停,因为每次迭代都会引起离线的QNN制备的高空性.
相比之下,Engine Agent利用其分级意识指数,直接将Python出口商中新引入的窗口-注意vit_合并所需的更改本地化,在两次尝试中成功输出模型,最终完成赋能.

blocks.en: Figure 11. Progress Comparison of Agents enabling MiniCPM-V 4.6 in ExecuTorch-QNN.
blocks.zh: 图11. ExecuTorch-QNN中使MiniCPM-V 4.6成为可能的代理人的进展比较。

blocks.en: 5.5. Cost Analysis for Pre-Constructed Index and Skills
blocks.zh: 5.5. 预构建指数和技能的成本分析

blocks.en:
The engine hierarchy-aware index and hardware-aware skills are pre-constructed once and reused across model-enablement tasks.
As engines evolve, they are incrementally updated only the parts that are affected by each commit.
We evaluate both their initial construction and incremental update costs below.
blocks.zh:
发动机分级意识指数和硬件意识技能预先构建一次,并跨模型意识任务重复使用.
随着引擎的发展,它们仅被逐渐更新到受到每项承诺影响的部分.
我们评价其初步建造和以下增量更新费用。

blocks.zh: 图表 5. 4个发动机快照的预适运文物初步建设成本.

blocks.en:
Table 5 reports the initial construction costs for the four evaluated engines.
Constructing the hierarchy index costs $0.66–$1.25, while hardware-aware skills cost $1.83–$2.68, averaging $0.93 and $2.30, respectively.
Thus, the reusable pre-enablement artifacts require only modest one-time construction cost.
blocks.zh:
表5汇报了4台经过评估的发动机的初步建造费用。
构建等级指数的费用为0.66美元-1.25美元,而硬件意识技能的费用为1.83美元-2.68美元,平均分别为0.93美元和2.30美元。
因此,可再利用的预开发文物只需要少量的一次性建筑费用。

blocks.en: Table 6. Update cost of pre-constructed artifacts across MNN versions.
blocks.zh: 表6. 跨MNN版本的预建文物更新成本.

blocks.en:
Table 6 reports the incremental cost across five consecutive MNN updates.
On average, updating the hierarchy index costs only $0.0077 and updating the hardware-aware skills costs $0.0646 per commit, corresponding to only 0.7% and 3.5% of their initial construction costs, respectively.
Combined, each update costs only $0.072 on average, about 2.5% of the initial pre-construction cost, demonstrating that the reusable artifacts can be maintained with very low overhead as the engine evolves.
blocks.zh:
表6汇报了连续五次多边网络网更新的增量成本。
平均而言,更新等级指数的费用仅为0.0077美元,更新硬件意识技能费用为每笔承付款0.0646美元,分别只占其最初建造费用的0.7%和3.5%。
综合起来,每次更新平均成本只有0.072美元,约为初步开工前成本的2.5%,表明随着发动机的进化,可重复使用的文物可以用非常低的间接费用来维护.

blocks.en: 5.6. Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5.6. 读取研究

blocks.en: We ablate the two pre-constructed components of EngineAgent to quantify their contributions. As shown in Figure 12 , removing the hierarchy-aware index reduces end-to-end success from 9/12 to 3/12 and increases average exploration turns from 42 to 271, showing that explicit hierarchy knowledge is critical for recovering complete implementation scopes and cross-layer dependencies. Removing the hardware-aware skills reduces success from 9/12 to 5/12 and increases compilation/debugging failures from 11 to 83, highlighting the importance of pre-validated build, verification, and debugging workflows for reliable hardware-grounded execution. Together, these results show that the two components are complementary: hierarchy-aware indexing guides complete implementation, while hardware-aware skills enable reliable on-device validation and debugging.
blocks.zh: 我们放弃了发动机代理公司两个预先建造的部件,以量化它们的贡献。 如图12所示,取消分级意识指数将端到端的成功率从9/12降至3/12,并将平均探索转折率从42转增至271转,表明明确的分级知识对于恢复完整的实施范围和跨层依赖性至关重要. 取消硬件意识技能将成功率从9/12降至5/12,并将编译/调试失败率从11提高到83,凸显了预先验证的构建,校验,调试工作流程对可靠硬件基于执行的重要性. 这些结果共同表明,这两个组成部分是互补的:分级-意识索引制导完成实施,而硬件-意识技能则能够可靠地进行在线验证和调试.

blocks.en: 6. Related Works
blocks.zh: 6个 相关作品

blocks.en: 6.1. General-Purpose Coding Agents
blocks.zh: 6.1. 一般目的编码代理人

blocks.en:
Commercial coding agents ( GitHub, 2026 ; Anysphere, Inc., 2026 ; Anthropic, 2026 ; OpenAI, 2026 ) , SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , and OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025b ) integrate repository exploration, editing, and execution feedback.
Agentless ( Xia et al., 2025 ) structures issue resolution into localization, repair, and validation.
Repository understanding draws on dependency-aware planning ( Bairi et al., 2024 ) , code graphs ( Ouyang et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , and program structure ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) .
Other work supports interactive debugging ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) , reusable skills learned from execution traces ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , and tree search with agent-based evaluation ( Antoniades et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en: 6.2. Mobile Programming and Deployment Agents
blocks.zh: 6.2. 流动方案编制和部署代理

blocks.en: AutoIOT ( Shen et al., 2025b ) and GPIoT ( Shen et al., 2025a ) synthesize AIoT programs from natural-language requirements, while AgentDeploy ( Shen et al., 2026 ) partitions models across existing inference engines and reuses optimization configurations for mobile deployment. At the operator level, MoKA, introduced in MobileKernelBench ( Zou et al., 2026 ) , combines repository-aware reasoning with iterative implementation and on-device validation. EngineAgent targets complete support for previously unsupported LLM and multimodal architectures, requiring coordinated changes across model conversion, graph construction, runtime-state management, and backend execution, validated through end-to-end execution on the target device.
blocks.zh: AutoIOT(Shen等人,2025b)和GPioT(Shen等人,2025a)从自然语言要求中合成了AIoT程序,而AgentDeploy(Shen等人,2026年)则将模型隔开,跨越现有的推论引擎,再利用优化配置用于移动部署. 在运营商层面,MoKA在MobileKernel Bench(Zou等人,2026年)中引入,将寄存器-意识推理与迭代执行和在线验证相结合. EngineAgent目标完整支持之前不支持的LLM和多式联运架构,需要跨模型转换,图表构建,运行时态管理,以及后端执行,通过目标设备的端到端执行验证.

blocks.en: 6.3. Automation of ML Systems
blocks.zh: 6.3. ML系统的自动化

blocks.en:
TVM ( Chen et al., 2018 ) , Ansor ( Zheng et al., 2020 ) , Roller ( Zhu et al., 2022 ) , and Welder ( Shi et al., 2023 ) automate tensor compilation and optimization through graph transformations, scheduling, search, and fusion.
KernelBench ( Ouyang et al., 2025a ) evaluates LLM-generated GPU kernels, while GEAK ( Wang et al., 2025a ) and KernelAgent ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) guide kernel optimization with execution feedback and hardware information.

Kernel Bench(欧阳等人,2025a)评价LLM生成的GPU内核,而GEAK(王等人,2025a)和KernelAgent(程等人,2026)则通过执行反馈和硬件信息指导内核优化.

blocks.en: 7. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7. 结论

blocks.en: Supporting rapidly evolving LLMs on heterogeneous mobile hardware makes model enablement a recurring cross-layer systems challenge. We presented EngineAgent, which separates reusable engine and hardware knowledge from model-specific implementation. Its hierarchy-aware index guides coordinated changes across engine abstractions, while hardware-aware workflows and a builder–auditor loop ground implementation and debugging in device-side validation. Our evaluation shows that this design improves model-enablement success while reducing time and model-API cost compared with coding-agent baselines. More broadly, EngineAgent offers a path to turn specialized integration expertise into reusable infrastructure, reducing the gap between model innovation and deployment across diverse hardware.
blocks.zh: 在各种移动硬件上支持快速变化的有限责任公司,使模型赋能成为反复出现的跨层系统挑战。 我们提出了引擎代理,它将可重复使用的引擎和硬件知识与模型特定实施区分开来. 它的分级感知索引指导了不同引擎抽象体之间协调的变化,而硬件感知工作流程和构建器–审计器环路地面执行以及设备侧面验证中的调试. 我们的评价表明,这种设计提高了模型开发成功率,同时与编码剂基线相比减少了时间和模型-API成本。 更广泛地说,Engine Agent为将专业集成专长转变为可再利用的基础设施提供了一个途径,缩小了模型创新与跨不同硬件部署之间的差距.
